design: Compare compensated aperture standard deviation with diagonal-only noise on flat and short-dark pair differences, separately by Bayer parity. Use nonoverlapping 7x7 windows with the same position and validity masks in both kinds. Fit the median empirical-to-diagonal factor on fixed training pairs and tiles, and check it on the intersection of held-out pairs and tiles.
comparison: Held-out P90 relative error of the trained factor versus a factor of one. Keep the original pairing, nuisance illumination adjustment and hot pixel exclusions.
